name: latex_table
description: Turn CSV text into a LaTeX tabular: the ten special characters (# $ % & { } _ ~ ^ \) escaped as the LaTeX reference manual prescribes, numeric columns right-aligned automatically or alignment given, \hline or booktabs rules, optional siunitx S columns, caption and label in a table float. Returns the LaTeX and the packages it needs.

align.description: One letter per column; default automatic

catalog.source: original; escaping as in the LaTeX2e unofficial reference manual (latexref.xyz), 23.1 Printing special characters; booktabs and siunitx package conventions
